narration: AI can generate almost anything. The harder problem is knowing when the result is wrong.
HAL Science Director makes the intended scientific claim explicit before generation.
A separate visual review examines the rendered artifact instead of trusting the generator.
When the result is attractive but scientifically weak, HAL rejects it and turns the visible failure into the next correction.
Every run can carry its plan, review, artifact lineage, and provenance receipt. Generation is not acceptance.
master_acceptance: Headless processes may use verified TELEMETRY REPLAY; no fabricated GUI is permitted.
Every product claim is backed by visible real evidence.
No synthetic proof UI or fake terminal output.
No freeze span longer than 2.0 seconds unless explicitly approved as an editorial hold.
No unintended black span longer than 1.5 seconds.
1920x1080 minimum, 24 fps target, 48 kHz final audio.
Full decode, motion QC, technical QC, SHA-256, and review receipt pass before release.
